name: Segment And Quantify Cells In Multiplexed Images
description: Segment cells and quantify protein expression levels from multichannel tissue images.
detailed_description: Segment cells and quantify protein expression levels from multichannel tissue images.
when_to_use: When you need segment and quantify cells in multiplexed images analysis

parameters.image_path: [Required] Path to the multichannel image file (tiff stack or similar format) (str)
parameters.markers_list: [Required] List of marker names corresponding to each channel in the image (List[str])
parameters.nuclear_channel_index: [Optional] Index of the nuclear marker channel (typically DAPI) (default: 0)
